game.title: Rage 2
game.blurb: Open-world post-apocalyptic first-person shooter from Avalanche Studios and id Software (with Virtuos and others, as RAWG lists them), released 2019-05-14. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, Racing. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Story milestones across the wasteland, all hidden on Steam. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Arks, EcoPods and the Wasteland
chapters.summary: Arks, the EcoPods of the Dune Sea, Broken Tract, Wetlands and Wilds, Trade Coalition settlements, balloons and spy drones.

chapters.title: Weapons, Abilities and Enemies
chapters.summary: Weapon tricks, Overdrive, Dash Strike, Slam, Defibrillation, the Wingstick, drones and kill counts against tougher enemies.

chapters.title: Vehicles, Convoys and Races
chapters.summary: The Phoenix, the Raptor, jumps and distance, convoy leaders, the Torn Plains race, the Dumper Truck and the Booma tank.

chapters.title: Nightmare, Ultra Nightmare and Ironman
chapters.summary: Finishing the game on the hardest settings and in Ironman Mode.

chapters.title: Overgrown City Missions
chapters.summary: Four named missions, the Overgrown City EcoPod, two Ark locations, a rebuild project, air drops and Ghost Sanctuaries.

chapters.title: Bonetowers and the Skeletal Army
chapters.summary: The five Bonetowers, returning the NECRODISC, and skeleton kills with the Sword of Transitus.

StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/RⒶGE_2

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). StrategyWiki redirects "Rage 2" to "RⒶGE 2" (completion stage 0); its Gameplay, Controls, Walkthrough and Achievements and trophies subpages are linked but not written, and only a "Table of Contents" subpage exists, so nothing was used. On rage.fandom.com, "Rage 2" redirects to "RAGE 2", with about 45 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam schema gives no game name for app 548570; the store list confirms it. 8 of 64 Steam achievements are hidden, all with high unlock rates (30% to 86%), and sit in the story chapter. The Overgrown City chapter is a guess from Steam list order: achievements 090 to 099 (four "Complete mission" ones, the Overgrown City EcoPod and air drops, two Ark locations and the Reclaim & Rebuild Project) sit together with unlock rates of about 4% to 14%, like add-on content, but no add-on name is in the fetched data. The Bonetower achievements (100 to 107) are grouped the same way. Steam API numbers skip many values (for example 006, 007, 010), so some achievements may have been removed.
